summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Gambling.com Group Ltd reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 20, 2026. The filing discloses that shareholders voted to approve the annual report, elect director nominees Johnny Hartnett and Carol Anderson as Class II directors, re-appoint BDO LLP as auditor, authorize the audit committee to set auditor remuneration, and approve a special resolution to amend the company's articles to permit a name change by board resolution. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or tender offer involved; it is a standard corporate governance update.
